description: GIRA - Bicicletas de Lisboa (Histórico) is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by EMEL. It provides information about the GIRA bicycle network in the city of Lisbon - location of stations, number of bicycles available and empty docks. Coverage: the city of Lisbon. The portal shows the English title as "GIRA - Bicycles of Lisbon (History)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is EMEL. Its keywords include gira, doca, dados-cm-lisboa-pt, mobilidade, mobilidade-suave, bikes. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
